title: Odile and the Songbook
author: Sable Dravenmoor
blurb: Mara Quintana, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
